review_scope: Read-only source review of the pending final-resource deadline patch in three files; the reviewed patch is a working-tree diff, not the executed HEAD cohort.
observations: finish_with_resource invokes the existing final resource callback once before inspecting the captured native Result.
Error precedence remains resource error, then original native error, then PUBLIC_REQUEST_DEADLINE only for otherwise successful outward results.
The same supplied deadline is tested after the final resource observation; no deadline refresh, new CPU operation, refund or Node-state mutation is introduced by the helper.
All three import wrappers call the helper at their original final-resource position. The observed wrapper keeps only kernel.verify inside observe_host(Final).
All four sync deadline fences sit inside the complete-page success branch after the original Host check. Earlier ? boundaries and incomplete/page-budget failures remain unchanged.
The priority/count matrix tests are designed to cover normal success, callback-caused expiry, resource/native error priority and mandatory final observation after pre-existing expiry.

The valid local import test is designed to preserve committed active/packet facts, exact CPU debit and settlement, zero reservations/in-flight state, and cold-reopen validity after only the final callback becomes late.
limitations: This reviewer did not run tests, build binaries, dispatch workflows or execute retained artifacts.
Test design was read only. No test PASS or current-head runtime qualification is claimed here.
The controlled final callback is not evidence of real fixed-Host provisioning, and this patch review claims no service-performance improvement.
